title: Design a Dashboard Card System with Components & Variants
description: Build reusable dashboard UI components with variants for different states
objective: Students will create a component-based dashboard card system with variants for different data types and states, then assemble them into a complete dashboard layout

steps.title: Create a Stats Card Component
steps.instructions:
Create a new page in your Figma file → name it "Dashboard".

Build a stats card (280×120):
1. Rectangle: Fill `#FFFFFF`, border-radius 12, border 1px `#E2E8F0`
2. Inside, add with Auto Layout (Vertical, padding 20, gap 8):
   - Label: "Total Revenue" — Inter Medium, 14px, `#64748B`
   - Value: "₹4,52,000" — Inter Bold, 28px, `#0F172A`
   - Change indicator: "↑ 12% from last month" — Inter Regular, 13px, `#10B981` (green)
3. Add a subtle icon placeholder (40×40 rounded rectangle, `#EEF2FF`) in the top-right corner

Select the entire card → **Ctrl+Alt+K** (Create Component).
Rename to **"Stats Card"**.

Now create **Variants** (select component → right panel → Add Variant):
- **Default**: Green change text (positive) — "↑ 12%"
- **Negative**: Red change text — "↓ 5%" in `#EF4444`
- **Neutral**: Gray change text — "— No change" in `#64748B`

Label the variant property as "trend" with values: positive, negative, neutral.

steps.title: Create a Table Row Component
steps.instructions:
Build a data table row (full width × 52):
1. Use Auto Layout (Horizontal)
2. Add 5 cells with fixed widths:
   - Name: "Rahul Sharma" — 180px, Inter Regular, 14px
   - Course: "ADCA" — 100px
   - Amount: "₹35,000" — 100px, right-aligned
   - Status: "Active" badge (pill shape) — 80px
   - Date: "23-Jul-2026" — 120px
3. Bottom border: 1px `#F1F5F9`

Status badge variants:
- **Active**: background `#DCFCE7`, text `#16A34A`
- **Pending**: background `#FEF9C3`, text `#CA8A04`
- **Completed**: background `#DBEAFE`, text `#2563EB`

Create component with "status" variant property.

Duplicate the row component to create a **Header Row** variant:
- Bold text, background `#F8FAFC`, no bottom border
- Font: Inter SemiBold

steps.title: Create a Chart Placeholder
steps.instructions:
Build a chart card (560×320):
1. White rectangle with border-radius 12 and border
2. Title section (Auto Layout horizontal):
   - "Revenue Overview" — Inter SemiBold, 16px
   - Spacer (fill)
   - Period selector: "Last 7 days ▾" — 14px, `#64748B`
3. Chart area: Rectangle 520×240, fill `#F8FAFC`
   - Draw simple bar shapes to simulate a bar chart
   - Or add text "Chart.js / Recharts will render here"
4. X-axis labels: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

Create a second variant for **Line Chart** style.

For real projects, this placeholder gets replaced with actual chart libraries (Chart.js, Recharts) during development.

steps.title: Assemble the Dashboard
steps.instructions:
Create a frame: **Desktop (1440×900)** or custom 1280×900.

Background: `#F1F5F9`

Build the layout:

**Top bar (full width × 64):**
- White background
- Logo left, search bar center, user avatar right

**Sidebar (240 × full height):**
- Dark background `#0F172A`
- Nav items: Dashboard, Students, Courses, Reports, Settings
- Active item highlighted with `#6366F1` background

**Main content area:**
1. Page title: "Dashboard" — Inter Bold, 24px
2. Stats cards row: Place 4 instances of Stats Card
   - Total Revenue, Total Students, Active Courses, Completion Rate
   - Use different "trend" variants (positive, negative, neutral)
3. Chart section: 2 chart cards side by side
4. Table section: Title "Recent Enrollments" + header row + 5 data rows
   - Use different "status" variants

Use Auto Layout for the main content:
- Vertical direction
- Gap: 24 between sections

steps.title: Export and Handoff
steps.instructions:
1. **Select any component** → check the right panel **Design** tab
   - Note all spacing values, colors, and font specs
   - This is what developers will read

2. **Export assets:**
   - Select the logo → Export as SVG
   - Select an icon → Export as SVG
   - Select the full dashboard → Export as 1x PNG

3. **Create a handoff page:**
   - New Figma page → "Developer Specs"
   - List all colors used with hex codes
   - List all fonts and sizes
   - List spacing values (padding, gaps)
   - Add any notes for the developer

4. **Share the file:**
   - Click Share → change access to "Anyone with the link can view"
   - Copy the link

**Submit:** Figma share link + exported dashboard PNG.

expected_output: A Figma file containing reusable component library (Stats Card with 3 variants, Table Row with status variants, Chart placeholders) assembled into a complete admin dashboard layout with proper design system documentation
